sentences.en: Please do your chores before you go out to play.
sentences.zh: 在你出去玩之前，请先做你的家务。

sentences.en: I have a few household chores that I must do.
sentences.zh: 我有一些家庭琐事必须处理。

sentences.en: I can't go out because I have chores to do.
sentences.zh: 因为我有家务要做，所以我不能出去。

senses.zh: 零星工作（尤指家常杂务）,令人讨厌的或繁重的工作
